papers.title: Learning a calibrated decision head from logged bandit feedback
papers.translated_title: 从记录的赌博机反馈中学习校准的决策头
papers.author: Ye Yuan
papers.summary: A decision head reads a state and a list of options and returns a probability per option in one forward pass. Once deployed, it usually observes only whether the option it chose was right: logged bandit feedback. We adapt such a head, LoRA on Qwen3-0.6B-Base and 1.7B-Base, from that feedback and report three results. First, the Brier or log score of the sampled action's own probability is not a usable REINFORCE reward: every wrong action earns at least gold's reward, with a mean baseline the lowest-probability wrong action gets the largest advantage, and at two options the signal is zero; in one run it cut accuracy on ordered-scale questions from .636 to .111. Scoring the probability as a loss by the pathwise gradient avoids the collapse, as do the REINFORCE rewards r and r minus p. Second, with full labels, none of four tested bandit arms beat cross-entropy plus one temperature on mean expected calibration error (ECE) over four unseen label schemas. Third, from logged feedback alone, Chosen-Action Proper Scoring (CAPS), the direct method with a proper score on the chosen action's probability, beats fine-tuning on confirmed answers only, which discards negatives: on Banking77 by 2.6 accuracy points, .053 lower ECE and lower selective risk (three seeds against one baseline seed), and by 21.7 points on one seed on emotion data with an often-wrong logger. At N 5000, CAPS stays 1.5 points below full-label training at 0.6B and .6 points at 1.7B against one full-label seed, and propensity weights add nothing on this log. Under feedback flipped at a known rate, one seed per rate, CAPS's confidence tracks the noisy channel on average, backward correction recovers most of the clean calibration, and early stopping on held-out logged outcomes prevented memorising noisy draws in all three runs. Code, adapters, logs and per-record results are public.
papers.translated_summary: 一个决策头读取状态和选项列表，并在一次前向传播中返回每个选项的概率。部署后，它通常只能观察到所选选项是否正确：即记录式的赌博机反馈。我们基于该反馈，在 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 和 1.7B-Base 上通过 LoRA 适配这样的决策头，并报告三项结果。第一，采样动作自身概率的 Brier 分数或对数分数不能作为可用的 REINFORCE 奖励：每个错误动作至少获得与正确动作相同的奖励；在均值基线下方，概率最低的错误动作获得最大优势；在两个选项时信号为零；在一次运行中，它将有序尺度问题的准确率从 .636 降至 .111。通过路径导数将概率作为损失进行评分可避免这种崩溃，REINFORCE 奖励 r 和 r 减 p 也是如此。第二，在完整标签下，四种测试的赌博机方案在四个未见标签模式上的平均期望校准误差（ECE）均未超过交叉熵加一个温度参数。第三，仅从记录式反馈出发，Chosen-Action Proper Scoring（CAPS），即在所选动作概率上使用适当评分的直接方法，优于仅在确认答案上微调（后者丢弃负例）：在 Banking77 上准确率高 2.6 个百分点，ECE 低 .053，选择性风险更低（三个种子对一个基线种子）；在记录器经常出错的情绪数据上，单种子下高 21.7 个百分点。在 N 5000 时，CAPS 在 0.6B 上比完整标签训练低 1.5 个百分点，在 1.7B 上低 .6 个百分点（对一个完整标签种子），且倾向权重在此日志上无增益。在已知翻转率的反馈下（每个翻转率一个种子），CAPS 的置信度平均上跟踪噪声信道，反向校正恢复了大部分干净校准，且基于留出记录式结果的早停在所有三次运行中防止了记忆噪声抽样。代码、适配器、日志和逐记录结果均已公开。

papers.title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
papers.translated_title: TraceKV：面向推理视觉语言模型的策略保持低秩KV缓存压缩
papers.author: Ke Li
papers.summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.
papers.translated_summary: 推理视觉语言模型（VLMs）因大规模多模态上下文和不断增长的推理轨迹而面临巨大的KV缓存需求。低秩KV压缩已成为一种有前景的范式，它存储KV状态的低维潜变量，并可与量化结合使用。然而，现有低秩方法在压缩推理KV状态时，往往会导致相对于稠密模型不断增长的预测策略漂移，从而造成推理失败。我们识别出这种性能退化的两个关键原因：静态上下文与在策略推理状态之间的校准状态失配，以及KV状态之间不相等的误差敏感性。为解决这些挑战，我们提出TraceKV，一个免训练的低秩KV压缩框架，在单一策略保持原则下统一了在策略校准、敏感性感知SVD和全局秩分配，大幅降低了推理过程中的策略-KL散度。在多个VLMs和视觉推理基准上的实验展示了更优的精度-内存权衡，与量化结合时在5.64倍KV缓存压缩下实现近乎无损的推理精度。优化的低秩注意力内核进一步带来高达1.83倍的端到端解码加速。代码将发布于https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV。

papers.title: Can We Make an LLM Dumber, or Is It Just Playing Dumb? An Empirical Study of Believable Performance Throttling
papers.translated_title: 我们能否让大语言模型变笨，还是它只是在装傻？一项关于可信性能节流的实证研究
papers.author: Chengguang Gan
papers.summary: A benchmark score is commonly read as a proxy for model capability. We study the inverse problem: can a model be driven to a target score, and do its failures resemble those of a naturally weaker model? We operationalize believable performance reduction along three axes: target calibration, item-difficulty structure, and error-distribution similarity to a real weak reference. We introduce CapLadder, an IRT-calibrated suite of 1,985 items spanning mathematics, code, multiple-choice reasoning, and tool use. A simple weak-teacher LoRA dial reaches unseen target levels on reasoning with a 1.9-point held-out calibration error, whereas prompting, temperature, and weight noise cannot combine comparable range and precision. Yet on multiple choice, the dial converges to an answer-token attractor: up to 97% of its newly introduced errors land on one letter, with the attractor changing from D in Qwen to A in Llama. Logit interventions identify a dominant near-constant shift: subtracting the estimated shift on held-out items recovers 52 to 59% of lost accuracy and removes the dominant attractor, while option permutation confirms that the bias tracks token position rather than option content. With high inter-annotator agreement ($κ=0.94$), human-coded error-category distributions nonetheless match the weak reference on reasoning (JS = 0.00), showing that local plausibility and aggregate detectability differ. Structured tool calls exhibit more natural degradation in the Qwen family (JS = 0.09), while a globally calibrated dial transfers poorly across benchmarks (14.2-point error on two usable benchmarks). Precise score control, therefore, does not imply a portable or believable reduction in skill.
papers.translated_summary: 基准分数通常被解读为模型能力的代理指标。我们研究其逆问题：模型能否被驱动至目标分数，其失败是否类似于天然较弱模型的失败？我们从三个维度操作化可信的性能下降：目标校准、项目难度结构，以及与真实弱参考模型的错误分布相似性。我们提出CapLadder，一个经IRT校准的测试套件，包含1,985个项目，涵盖数学、代码、多项选择推理和工具使用。一个简单的弱教师LoRA调节器在推理任务上达到未见过的目标水平，留出校准误差为1.9个百分点，而提示、温度和权重噪声无法结合可比的范围和精度。然而在多项选择上，该调节器收敛到一个答案词元吸引子：其新引入的错误中高达97%落在一个字母上，吸引子在Qwen中从D变化到Llama中的A。Logit干预识别出一个主导的近常数偏移：在留出项目上减去估计的偏移可恢复52%至59%的损失准确率并消除主导吸引子，而选项排列确认该偏差追踪的是词元位置而非选项内容。在标注者间高度一致（κ=0.94）的情况下，人工编码的错误类别分布在推理任务上仍与弱参考模型匹配（JS = 0.00），表明局部合理性与聚合可检测性存在差异。结构化工具调用在Qwen系列中表现出更自然的退化（JS = 0.09），而全局校准的调节器在不同基准之间迁移效果不佳（在两个可用基准上误差为14.2个百分点）。因此，精确的分数控制并不意味着可迁移或可信的技能下降。

papers.title: Observations Drift, Structures Remain: Structural Pretraining with Time Alignment for Electromagnetic Signals
papers.translated_title: 观测漂移，结构留存：面向电磁信号的时间对齐结构预训练
papers.author: Wenjin Gui
papers.summary: Electromagnetic signal modeling is increasingly moving toward self-supervised pretraining on heterogeneous I/Q observations. However, an observed waveform is jointly shaped by signal generation, propagation environments, and acquisition processes, which mix reusable structural regularities with observation-specific variations. Existing methods usually pursue unified pretraining with reconstruction objectives on mixed observations. This heterogeneity creates two key mismatches for reconstruction pretraining: (1) appearance mismatch, induced by propagation-dependent waveform variations; and (2) temporal mismatch, induced by acquisition-dependent sampling coordinates. These mismatches make observation-specific appearances and sampling coordinates easier to reconstruct than stable signal structures, inducing observational shortcuts. We identify this failure mode as observation-biased pretraining. To address this, we propose Structural Pretraining with Time Alignment for heterogeneous EM signals. It mitigates temporal mismatch with RoPE-fs, which maps token positions to sampling-rate-normalized physical-time positions, and reduces reliance on appearance shortcuts by replacing waveform reconstruction with masked prediction of discrete structural units. These units are organized into atomic structural units and emergent structural units that capture variable-length compositional patterns beyond fixed patch boundaries. Across diverse EM benchmarks, our method improves both full-supervision and few-shot adaptation over existing EM pretraining baselines, showing that the learned representations better preserve structural consistency when observations drift in waveform appearance and temporal scale.
papers.translated_summary: 电磁信号建模正日益转向对异构I/Q观测的自监督预训练。然而，观测到的波形由信号生成、传播环境和采集过程共同塑造，其中混合了可复用的结构规律与观测特定的变化。现有方法通常对混合观测采用重建目标进行统一预训练。这种异构性为重建预训练带来了两个关键失配：（1）外观失配，由传播相关的波形变化引起；（2）时间失配，由采集相关的采样坐标引起。这些失配使得观测特定的外观和采样坐标比稳定的信号结构更容易被重建，从而诱发观测捷径。我们将这一失效模式识别为观测偏置预训练。为解决这一问题，我们提出了面向异构电磁信号的时间对齐结构预训练。它通过RoPE-fs缓解时间失配，该方法将token位置映射到采样率归一化的物理时间位置，并通过用离散结构单元的掩码预测替代波形重建，减少对外观捷径的依赖。这些单元被组织为原子结构单元和涌现结构单元，后者捕获超越固定patch边界的变长组合模式。在多样化的电磁基准上，我们的方法在全监督和少样本适应方面均优于现有电磁预训练基线，表明当观测在波形外观和时间尺度上发生漂移时，所学表示能更好地保持结构一致性。

papers.title: What Conformal Selection Can Certify in CRISPR Off-Target Design:Benchmark Leakage, Free Baselines, and a Finite-Sample Cohort Requirement
papers.translated_title: 共形选择在CRISPR脱靶设计中能证明什么：基准泄漏、免费基线与有限样本队列要求
papers.author: Mohammad Malekpouri
papers.summary: Conformal selection promises distribution-free, finite-sample control of the error rate of a decision, and has been proposed as a safety layer for machine-learning CRISPR guide design. We ask whether such a certificate is attainable from the validated off-target data that exist. The constraint is arithmetic: a conformal p-value cannot fall below one divided by the calibration cohort size plus one, so a Benjamini-Hochberg selection certifies a single candidate only when that cohort is at least the candidate pool size divided by the tolerated error rate. Public cohorts supply ten validated guides, whereas a pool of two thousand at a ten percent error rate needs twenty thousand; the accepted set is consequently empty in over ninety-six percent of splits. Two benchmarking findings explain why this went unnoticed. The standard CIRCLE-seq file lists ten guides under eighty on-target strings, so grouping cross-validation on the sequence column trains and tests on one guide; corrected, pair-level discrimination and per-guide fidelity collapse. With that leakage removed, a training-free position-weight score and a bare count of near-match genomic sites are not beaten by a trained oracle. We give the corrected protocol, the baselines a new model must beat, and the cohort size a certified pipeline needs.
papers.translated_summary: 共形选择承诺对决策错误率进行无分布、有限样本的控制，并已被提出作为机器学习CRISPR引导设计的安全层。我们追问：从现有的已验证脱靶数据中，这样的证书是否可获得。约束是算术性的：共形p值不能低于校准队列规模加一后的倒数，因此Benjamini-Hochberg选择只有在队列规模至少为候选池规模除以容忍错误率时，才能认证单个候选。公共队列提供十个已验证引导，而两千个候选池在百分之十错误率下需要两万个；因此，在超过百分之九十六的划分中，接受集为空。两项基准测试发现解释了为何这一点未被注意到。标准CIRCLE-seq文件在八十个on-target字符串下列出十个引导，因此按序列列进行分组交叉验证会在一 个引导上训练和测试；纠正后，配对级判别和逐引导保真度崩溃。去除该泄漏后，无训练的位置权重评分和近匹配基因组位点的裸计数不会被训练过的oracle击败。我们给出纠正后的协议、新模型必须击败的基线，以及认证流水线所需的队列规模。

papers.title: Testing Conversation Preservation Across LLM APIs: A Rule-Based Oracle for Detecting Silent Information Loss
papers.translated_title: 测试跨LLM API的对话保持：一种用于检测静默信息丢失的基于规则的预言机
papers.author: Xin Liu
papers.summary: LLM applications increasingly rely on translators and compatibility layers to move conversations across APIs. Yet a translated request can be accepted by the target API while silently losing information about instruction roles, tool interactions, error states, or generation controls. We introduce isloss, a deterministic oracle for testing conversation-information preservation across LLM API translations. It maps source and translated requests and replies to a shared intermediate representation, ConvIR, and applies explicit rules to distinguish legitimate representation changes from information loss. Unlike schema validation or reference-based differential testing, isloss requires neither a reference translation nor additional model calls. It also distinguishes avoidable loss from degradation caused by target API limitations. We evaluate isloss using specification-based fault injection, human review, and experiments on translators, gateways, and client libraries. On held-out tests, it detects 95/125 planted faults (76.0%) with 2/100 false alarms (2.0%). Across a synthetic request suite spanning six configurations of five translator codebases, 127/685 completed translations (18.5%) pass static target checks while silently changing prompt, role, or tool information in ways the target API could have preserved. In translated replies, 203/558 streams (36.4%) cause exceptions or silent corruption in at least one tested official OpenAI SDK. Targeted experiments across six models show that translation-induced changes can alter model behaviour when tasks depend on the affected information. These results establish conversation preservation as a distinct correctness requirement for reliable LLM interoperability, agent execution, and model evaluation.
papers.translated_summary: LLM 应用日益依赖翻译器和兼容层来跨 API 迁移对话。然而，一个经过翻译的请求可能被目标 API 接受，却在无声中丢失关于指令角色、工具交互、错误状态或生成控制的信息。我们提出 isloss，一种确定性预言机，用于测试跨 LLM API 翻译的对话信息保持性。它将源请求与回复以及翻译后的请求与回复映射到一个共享中间表示 ConvIR，并应用显式规则来区分合法的表示变更与信息丢失。与模式验证或基于参考的差分测试不同，isloss 既不需要参考翻译，也不需要额外的模型调用。它还能区分可避免的丢失与由目标 API 限制导致的降级。我们使用基于规范的故障注入、人工评审以及在翻译器、网关和客户端库上的实验来评估 isloss。在留出测试中，它检测出 125 个植入故障中的 95 个（76.0%），误报为 2/100（2.0%）。在覆盖五个翻译器代码库六种配置的合成请求套件中，685 个完成的翻译中有 127 个（18.5%）通过了静态目标检查，却在目标 API 本可保留的情况下无声地改变了提示、角色或工具信息。在翻译后的回复中，558 个流中有 203 个（36.4%）在至少一个受测的官方 OpenAI SDK 中导致异常或无声损坏。跨六个模型的有针对性实验表明，当任务依赖受影响的信息时，翻译引起的变化会改变模型行为。这些结果确立了对话保持性作为可靠 LLM 互操作、智能体执行和模型评估的一项独立正确性要求。

papers.title: Faithful in Steps: Improving Generalization and Citation in RAG via Query Decomposition
papers.translated_title: 忠实于步骤：通过查询分解提升RAG中的泛化性与引用
papers.author: Yue Liu
papers.summary: Retrieval-augment generation is a prevalent strategy to mitigate hallucinations of LLMs. The attributable RAG (RAGQ) generates quotes for its answers. The quotes indicate which input contexts support the RAG to derive the answers, enhancing the answer's verifiability and trustworthiness. However, existing RAGQs exhibit significant degradation when dealing with questions that require multi-hop reasoning and multi-modal understanding, suffering from over-citation, implicit entity identification failure, and poor generalization. In this paper, we propose a novel RAGQ framework, namely QDRAG. QDRAG breaks down the input question into atomic subquestions to identify the implicit entities. Then, the reranker prunes context distractors to eliminate the downstream over-citation. To facilitate query decomposition, we propose two zero-shot approaches: QD-C and QD-R, which guide the QD MLLM to decompose the question based on context knowledge and retrieval rewards, respectively. One interesting finding is that finetuning on the QD task shows better generalizability compared to directly finetuning on the downstream RAGQ task. Experiments on four multi-modal QA benchmarks demonstrate QDRAG's efficacy in grounding answers and generating faithful citations. The framework significantly outperforms all the baselines on both in-domain and out-of-domain tests, even surpassing Gemini-Pro.
papers.translated_summary: 检索增强生成是缓解大语言模型幻觉的一种普遍策略。可归因RAG（RAGQ）为其答案生成引文。引文指示哪些输入上下文支持RAG推导出答案，从而增强答案的可验证性和可信度。然而，现有RAGQ在处理需要多跳推理和多模态理解的问题时表现出显著退化，存在过度引用、隐式实体识别失败和泛化能力差等问题。本文提出了一种新颖的RAGQ框架，即QDRAG。QDRAG将输入问题分解为原子子问题以识别隐式实体。然后，重排序器剪枝上下文干扰项以消除下游的过度引用。为促进查询分解，我们提出了两种零样本方法：QD-C和QD-R，分别基于上下文知识和检索奖励引导QD MLLM分解问题。一个有趣的发现是，在QD任务上微调相比直接在下游RAGQ任务上微调展现出更好的泛化能力。在四个多模态问答基准上的实验证明了QDRAG在答案归因和生成忠实引文方面的有效性。该框架在域内和域外测试中均显著优于所有基线，甚至超越了Gemini-Pro。

papers.title: Analysis choices decide whether untrained networks beat trained ones at V1: a multiverse analysis of model-brain RSA
papers.translated_title: 分析选择决定未经训练的网络是否在V1上胜过训练过的网络：模型-大脑RSA的多宇宙分析
papers.author: Nils Leutenegger
papers.summary: Untrained convolutional networks have been reported to rival trained networks as models of visual cortex, and we had reported an untrained-network advantage over backpropagation at V1 in THINGS fMRI, together with a dependence on evaluation resolution. Under a pre-specified ridge readout, the untrained network scored below the trained one at every pooling grid (median r difference -0.043 at g = 4, 0 of 5 seeds positive), and also in MSE skill and per-fold r. In exploratory analyses, across 36 combinations of unit normalisation, distance measure and voxel normalisation (28 distinct analyses), the sign of the V1 contrast depended on the analysis (intervals above 0 in 5 and below 0 in 9 distinct analyses), and in our networks the resolution dependence of the original convention appeared in only one cell. Raw correlation-distance representational similarity analysis (RSA) covaried with the alignment of model and voxel patterns with the unit-mean profile (Spearman 0.97 across our networks, 0.79 across six ImageNet architectures); the advantage was absent from the component orthogonal to the mean profile, and the parallel component alone did not resolve it. On the unweighted angular component of centred patterns, trained networks were ahead at V1 (our network and 5 of 6 ImageNet models) and at LOC (all seven); the norm-weighted angular term was not resolved. A luminance-and-contrast bank scored above every network under ridge (point estimates), and adding network features under a shared penalty did not improve prediction. Intervals are stimulus-bootstrap intervals for three subjects, and 6 pre-stated predictions were not met. We recommend reporting sensitivity to centring over the evaluated stimuli on both sides, reporting components separately, and including a small multiverse and simple baselines.
papers.translated_summary: 已有报告称，未经训练的卷积网络作为视觉皮层模型可与训练过的网络相媲美；我们曾报告，在THINGS fMRI的V1区，未训练网络相对于反向传播具有优势，且这种优势依赖于评估分辨率。在预先设定的岭读出下，未训练网络在每个池化网格上的得分都低于训练过的网络（g = 4时r差值中位数为-0.043，5个种子中0个为正），在MSE技能和逐折r上也是如此。在探索性分析中，在单元归一化、距离度量和体素归一化的36种组合（28种不同分析）中，V1对比的方向取决于分析方式（5种不同分析中区间高于0，9种中低于0），而在我们的网络中，原始约定下的分辨率依赖性仅出现在一个单元格中。原始相关-距离表征相似性分析（RSA）与模型和体素模式相对于单位均值轮廓的对齐程度共变（我们的网络间Spearman为0.97，六个ImageNet架构间为0.79）；该优势在正交于均值轮廓的分量中不存在，而仅平行分量也无法解释它。在中心化模式的未加权角度分量上，训练过的网络在V1区领先（我们的网络和6个ImageNet模型中的5个），在LOC区也领先（全部七个）；范数加权角度项未能解释。一个亮度与对比度滤波器组在岭回归下得分高于每个网络（点估计），而在共享惩罚下添加网络特征并未改善预测。区间为三名受试者的刺激自助法区间，且有6项预先声明的预测未得到满足。我们建议报告对两侧所评估刺激上中心化处理的敏感性，分别报告各分量，并纳入一个小型多宇宙分析和简单基线。

papers.title: MAGIC: Modality-Aware Gini Inspection for Clinical Hallucination Detection in LMMs
papers.translated_title: MAGIC：面向LMM临床幻觉检测的模态感知基尼检查
papers.author: Sachin Acharya
papers.summary: Recent advances in medical large multimodal models (LMMs) have brought promising progress to clinical decision support, yet hallucination, the generation of confident but clinically unverifiable outputs, poses a critical threat to the reliability demanded in high-stakes medical settings. Existing hallucination detection methods, predominantly designed for unimodal settings, fail to capture the visual-linguistic dynamics inherent to medical imaging. We formulate the problem of hallucination detection in LMMs as disproportionate distribution of attention weights across the modalities during answer token generation. We quantify modality-specific attention concentration across layers and heads using the Gini coefficient and demonstrate statistically significant redistribution of attention mass between visual and textual tokens in hallucinated responses. We leverage these features to train a logistic regression-based classifier and evaluate it on two medical LMMs across three medical imaging modalities, demonstrating that our method achieves competitive or superior performance against contemporary hallucination detection baselines.
papers.translated_summary: 医学大型多模态模型（LMMs）的最新进展为临床决策支持带来了可期的进步，然而幻觉——即生成自信但临床无法验证的输出——对高风险医疗环境所要求的可靠性构成了严重威胁。现有的幻觉检测方法主要针对单模态场景设计，无法捕捉医学影像所固有的视觉—语言动态。我们将LMMs中的幻觉检测问题表述为答案词元生成过程中注意力权重跨模态的不均衡分布。我们使用基尼系数量化各层和各注意力头中模态特定的注意力集中度，并证明在幻觉响应中视觉词元与文本词元之间的注意力质量存在统计显著的重分配。我们利用这些特征训练了一个基于逻辑回归的分类器，并在两个医学LMMs上跨三种医学影像模态进行评估，结果表明我们的方法相较于当代幻觉检测基线取得了有竞争力或更优的性能。

papers.title: One Hierarchy, Many Sports: Hierarchy-Aligned Multi-Task Learning for Next-Shot Prediction
papers.translated_title: 一个层级，多种运动：面向下一拍预测的层级对齐多任务学习
papers.author: Chao-Wei Cai
papers.summary: Next-shot prediction in racket sports requires learning from event data with different match structures, recorded attributes, and label vocabularies. Table tennis, badminton, and tennis nevertheless share a hierarchy in which shots form rallies and rallies form higher scoring units. We present MT-HTA, a hierarchy-aligned multi-task Transformer that uses this structure to jointly predict the attributes of the next shot. A temporal Transformer captures event progression, a feature-token path models interactions among semantic fields rather than along the time axis, and task-specific attention retrieves information from hierarchical summaries and player context. The architecture supports three- and four-level hierarchies and sport-dependent task sets. Across four datasets from three sports, the final MT-HTA achieves the highest mean task-averaged F1 among the compared main models. Ablations on table tennis support the combination of hierarchical encoding, task attention, and feature-token interaction. Additional modules alter the balance between classification scores and spatial error rather than improving every metric. These results support a reusable architecture for heterogeneous racket-sport event data. We release the code for reproducibility. https://github.com/gndd1221/For-Sports-event-modeling-with-rally-and-score-hierarchical-A-Multi-Task-Hierarchical-Transformer
papers.translated_summary: 在球拍类运动中，下一拍预测需要从具有不同比赛结构、记录属性和标签词汇的事件数据中学习。然而，乒乓球、羽毛球和网球共享一种层级结构，即击球构成回合，回合构成更高层级的计分单元。我们提出MT-HTA，一种层级对齐的多任务Transformer，利用该结构联合预测下一拍的属性。时间Transformer捕捉事件进程，特征令牌路径建模语义字段之间的交互而非沿时间轴的交互，任务特定注意力从层级摘要和球员上下文中检索信息。该架构支持三级和四级层级以及依赖运动项目的任务集。在来自三种运动的四个数据集上，最终的MT-HTA在对比的主要模型中取得了最高的平均任务平均F1。在乒乓球上的消融实验支持层级编码、任务注意力和特征令牌交互的组合。额外模块改变了分类分数与空间误差之间的平衡，而非改善每一项指标。这些结果支持一种可复用的架构，用于异构球拍类运动事件数据。我们发布代码以保证可复现性。https://github.com/gndd1221/For-Sports-event-modeling-with-rally-and-score-hierarchical-A-Multi-Task-Hierarchical-Transformer

papers.title: Readout adaptation in simulated arm reaching: learned compensation and performance after updates stop
papers.translated_title: 模拟手臂伸展中的读出适应：学习到的补偿及更新停止后的表现
papers.author: Kobayashi, J.
papers.summary: When an arm learns to compensate for a force that deflects its movement, removing the force can produce an opposite deviation, or after-effect. We evaluate what the controller retains by measuring the after-effect, the learned torque correction, and tracking performance after weight updates stop. We use a simulated torque-driven planar two-link arm reaching in eight directions under velocity-dependent sideways forces. Only an external linear torque readout adapts online; the parameters generating its features stay fixed. Features come from three configurations of closed-form continuous-time (CfC) networks, an echo-state network, or a radial-basis-function layer. All three CfC configurations, including neural circuit policy wiring, are trained for 400 epochs. These five feature-based variants use least-mean-squares (LMS) learning; a sixth uses recursive least squares (RLS) on the dense-backbone CfC readout. Learning rates are selected on three model initializations and evaluated on ten separate initializations under three force fields. All six variants improve tracking relative to their fixed-readout baselines and pass our after-effect criterion in every evaluation run. Diagnostics on the same ten evaluation initializations in the main field (60 conditions) quantify differences behind this shared decision: the median normalized squared residual between the learned output change and ideal compensation ranges from 0.0097 to 0.383 across implementations on common prescribed inputs. With updates stopped and feedback control active, all final readouts retain useful compensation, reducing tracking error by 40-97% relative to their pre-adaptation versions. Compared with the final adaptive cycle, the five LMS variants have median fixed-readout error ratios of 2.28-5.87, while RLS remains nearly unchanged. These measurements distinguish the performance achieved during adaptation from that retained in the final weights. They provide a concrete evaluation procedure for readout adaptation: measure the learned output correction and test the final controller with updates off, alongside behavioral after-effects. The comparison characterizes complete implementations in this task; differences in preparation and hyperparameters limit attribution to feature representations or update rules alone.
papers.translated_summary: 当手臂学会补偿一个使其运动偏转的力时，移除该力会产生相反的偏差，即后效应。我们通过测量后效应、学习到的力矩校正以及权重更新停止后的跟踪性能，来评估控制器保留了哪些信息。我们使用一个模拟的力矩驱动的平面双连杆手臂，在速度相关的侧向力下向八个方向伸展。只有外部线性力矩读出器在线自适应；生成其特征的参数保持固定。特征来自三种闭式连续时间（CfC）网络配置、一个回声状态网络或一个径向基函数层。所有三种CfC配置，包括神经电路策略布线，均训练400个epoch。这五种基于特征的变体使用最小均方（LMS）学习；第六种在密集骨干CfC读出器上使用递归最小二乘（RLS）。学习率在三个模型初始化上选择，并在三个力场下的十个独立初始化上评估。所有六种变体相对于其固定读出基线均改善了跟踪性能，并在每次评估运行中通过了我们的后效应标准。在主力场中相同十个评估初始化（60种条件）上的诊断量化了这一共同决策背后的差异：在共同规定输入上，学习到的输出变化与理想补偿之间的中位数归一化平方残差在不同实现中范围为0.0097至0.383。在更新停止且反馈控制激活的情况下，所有最终读出器均保留了有用的补偿，相对于其预适应版本将跟踪误差降低了40-97%。与最终自适应周期相比，五种LMS变体的中位数固定读出误差比为2.28-5.87，而RLS几乎保持不变。这些测量区分了适应期间达到的性能与最终权重中保留的性能。它们为读出器适应提供了一种具体的评估程序：测量学习到的输出校正，并在更新关闭的情况下测试最终控制器，同时结合行为后效应。该比较表征了此任务中的完整实现；准备和超参数的差异限制了对特征表示或更新规则本身的归因。

papers.title: An expanded structural and biochemical map of GLI-SUFU recognition identifies binding-defective disease variants
papers.translated_title: GLI-SUFU识别的扩展结构与生化图谱鉴定出结合缺陷型疾病变异
papers.author: Bardwell, A. J.
papers.summary: The tumor suppressor SUFU is a key negative regulator of oncogenic GLI transcription factors. SUFU mutations predispose to medulloblastoma and can cause Gorlin and Joubert syndromes. Limited structural information is available on the GLI-SUFU complex, contributing to the fact that the vast majority of SUFU missense variants sequenced from affected patients are of unknown clinical significance. Using AlphaFold3 and complementary computational analysis, we predicted structures of the three human GLI-SUFU complexes and the orthologous Drosophila Ci-Sufu complex, revealing previously unrecognized contact interfaces. By site-directed mutagenesis and GLI-SUFU binding assays, we validated the importance of key interface residues, many of which are mutated in familial medulloblastoma and Gorlin syndrome. These findings provide new structure-function insights into a signaling complex mutated in cancer and rare congenital diseases, and offer an expanded framework for interpreting clinically observed SUFU variants and mechanisms that tune SUFU repression.
papers.translated_summary: 肿瘤抑制因子SUFU是致癌性GLI转录因子的关键负调控因子。SUFU突变易导致髓母细胞瘤，并可引发Gorlin综合征和Joubert综合征。关于GLI-SUFU复合物的结构信息有限，这导致从患者中测序得到的绝大多数SUFU错义变异具有未知的临床意义。我们利用AlphaFold3及互补的计算分析，预测了三种人类GLI-SUFU复合物及同源果蝇Ci-Sufu复合物的结构，揭示了此前未被识别的接触界面。通过定点诱变和GLI-SUFU结合实验，我们验证了关键界面残基的重要性，其中许多残基在家族性髓母细胞瘤和Gorlin综合征中发生突变。这些发现为一种在癌症和罕见先天性疾病中发生突变的信号复合物提供了新的结构与功能见解，并为解读临床观察到的SUFU变异及调控SUFU抑制作用的机制提供了扩展框架。

papers.title: Metabolic exploitation of the bacterial arginine deiminase pathway extends Caenorhabditis elegans healthspan
papers.translated_title: 细菌精氨酸脱亚胺酶途径的代谢利用延长秀丽隐杆线虫的健康寿命
papers.author: Ito, A.
papers.summary: While certain lactic acid bacteria extend Caenorhabditis elegans lifespan, the underlying mechanisms remain obscure. We investigated the lifespan-extending effects of Lactococcus lactis JCM 5805 (Lc5805). While live and heat-treated Lc5805 both extended mean lifespan, live Lc5805 uniquely prolonged maximum lifespan to 25 days, compared with 21 days for control and heat-treated groups. Ingesting live Lc5805 upregulated 74 cuticle-formation genes, predominantly collagen genes, supporting structural integrity without activating host stress responses. Metabolomic analyses revealed that live Lc5805 consumption induced L-citrulline and L-ornithine accumulation in C. elegans, which lacks a functional urea cycle. Intestinal expression of bacterial arginine deiminase (arcA), contrasted with the absence of citrulline accumulation in ADI-lacking bacteria and heat-treated groups, indicates that citrulline accumulation requires active bacterial enzymes to operate the arginine deiminase pathway in the gut. Through this 'metabolic exploitation', utilizing bacterial metabolites and enzymes for collagen maintenance, the host avoids endogenous energy expenditure.
papers.translated_summary: 虽然某些乳酸菌能延长秀丽隐杆线虫的寿命，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们研究了乳酸乳球菌JCM 5805（Lc5805）的延寿效应。活菌和热处理后的Lc5805均能延长平均寿命，但活菌Lc5805独特地将最大寿命延长至25天，而对照组和热处理组为21天。摄入活菌Lc5805上调了74个角质层形成基因，主要是胶原蛋白基因，在不激活宿主应激反应的情况下支持结构完整性。代谢组学分析显示，摄入活菌Lc5805诱导了秀丽隐杆线虫体内L-瓜氨酸和L-鸟氨酸的积累，而该线虫缺乏功能性尿素循环。肠道中细菌精氨酸脱亚胺酶（arcA）的表达，与缺乏ADI的细菌及热处理组中无瓜氨酸积累形成对比，表明瓜氨酸积累需要活跃的细菌酶在肠道中运行精氨酸脱亚胺酶途径。通过这种“代谢利用”，即利用细菌代谢物和酶进行胶原蛋白维护，宿主避免了内源性能量消耗。

papers.title: Ancestral polyploidy and non-linear dosage shifts define the photosynthetic transition in the Heliantheae alliance
papers.translated_title: 祖先多倍化与非线性剂量变化共同定义了向日葵族联盟的光合作用转变
papers.author: Bonthala, V.
papers.summary: Whole-genome duplications (WGDs) have played a central role in plant evolutionary innovation, yet their genome-wide influence on complex physiological traits such as carbon-concentrating mechanisms (CCMs) remains poorly resolved. Here, we present high-quality genome assemblies and annotations for 35 species within the Heliantheae alliance (Asteraceae), spanning the complex photosynthetic spectrum from C3 to C4. Ks-based analyses combined with gene tree-species tree reconciliation identified a shared paleopolyploid event (WGD-2) ~30 million years ago. Using phylogenetically informed association mapping with these species, we detected 451 functional MapMan BINs with copy number variation significantly associated with interspecific variation in the CO2 compensation point. Notably, 303 of these BINs contain greater than 10% WGD-2-derived genes, indicating a strong enrichment of duplicated loci within photosynthetically relevant functional modules. Effect-size analysis revealed that the C3-to-C4 transition is governed by threshold-dependent genomic architecture rather than gradual additive change. Substantial expansions in key transcription factor modules, including HD-ZIP, HSF, LOB, and TCP, were associated with strong non-linear physiological shifts, consistent with genomic tipping points. By integrating comparative genomics, physiological trait variation, and evolutionary analysis, this study establishes a mechanistic link between ancient polyploidy and contemporary photosynthetic diversification. These findings provide a framework for understanding the genetic basis of carbon concentrating mechanism evolution and inform future optimization of photosynthetic efficiency in Asteraceae crops such as sunflower.
papers.translated_summary: 全基因组复制（WGD）在植物演化创新中发挥了核心作用，然而其对碳浓缩机制（CCMs）等复杂生理性状的全基因组影响仍鲜有解析。本文报道了菊科向日葵族联盟内35个物种的高质量基因组组装与注释，涵盖从C3到C4的复杂光合作用谱系。基于Ks的分析结合基因树-物种树 reconciliation 鉴定出约3000万年前一次共享的古多倍化事件（WGD-2）。利用系统发育信息关联作图，我们检测到451个MapMan BIN的功能拷贝数变异与CO2补偿点的种间变异显著相关。值得注意的是，其中303个BIN含有超过10%的WGD-2来源基因，表明重复位点在光合相关功能模块中强烈富集。效应量分析揭示C3向C4的转变受阈值依赖的基因组架构调控，而非渐进式加性变化。关键转录因子模块（包括HD-ZIP、HSF、LOB和TCP）的大幅扩张与强烈的非线性生理转变相关，符合基因组临界点特征。通过整合比较基因组学、生理性状变异和演化分析，本研究建立了古老多倍化与当代光合多样化之间的机制联系。这些发现为理解碳浓缩机制演化的遗传基础提供了框架，并为向日葵等菊科作物光合效率的未来优化提供了参考。

papers.title: Defining the Xanthomonas euvesicatoria type II-secreted effector arsenal reveals key roles in bacterial nutrition and diversity across species
papers.translated_title: 定义Xanthomonas euvesicatoria II型分泌效应蛋白库揭示其在细菌营养和跨物种多样性中的关键作用
papers.author: Goll, S.
papers.summary: The type II secretion (T2S) system is conserved across the Xanthomonas lineage, yet its contributions to pathogenicity and secreted protein repertoires are poorly defined. We demonstrate that T2S systems in Xanthomonas pathovars with divergent hosts and lifestyles are required for disease. Quantification of the plant cell wall composition during infection by Xanthomonas euvesicatoria (Xe) revealed a T2S-dependent depletion of galacturonic acid, suggesting T2 effector (T2E)-mediated cell wall remodeling. Using an in planta label-free proteomics approach, we identified two known and 20 new Xe T2Es from tomato apoplast, most annotated as cell wall-degrading enzymes and proteases. In vitro growth assays showed a T2S-mediated utilization of plant cell wall polysaccharides and proteins by Xe, as well as by Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. glycines (Xag) and Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris (Xcc). Intriguingly, while families of cell wall-degrading enzymes are relatively well conserved across these three strains, protease repertoires have diversified significantly, suggesting more strain-specific functionalities. Our methodology establishes a framework for T2E discovery, enabling future functional dissection of this understudied effector class and its crosstalk with other bacterial virulence factors.
papers.translated_summary: II型分泌（T2S）系统在黄单胞菌谱系中保守存在，但其对致病性及分泌蛋白库的贡献尚不明确。我们证明，在宿主和生活方式存在差异的黄单胞菌致病变种中，T2S系统是致病所必需的。对辣椒斑点病菌（Xanthomonas euvesicatoria，Xe）侵染过程中植物细胞壁组成的定量分析揭示了半乳糖醛酸的T2S依赖性耗竭，提示T2效应蛋白（T2E）介导的细胞壁重塑。利用植物体内无标记蛋白质组学方法，我们从番茄质外体中鉴定出两个已知的和20个新的Xe T2E，其中大多数注释为细胞壁降解酶和蛋白酶。体外生长实验显示，Xe以及大豆致病变种Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. glycines（Xag）和野油菜黄单胞菌致病变种Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris（Xcc）均表现出T2S介导的植物细胞壁多糖和蛋白质利用。有趣的是，尽管细胞壁降解酶家族在这三个菌株间相对保守，但蛋白酶库已显著多样化，提示存在更多菌株特异性功能。我们的方法建立了T2E发现的框架，为未来对这一研究不足的效应蛋白类别及其与其他细菌毒力因子间交互作用的功能解析奠定了基础。

papers.title: Heat-induced increases in xylem vulnerability: Experimental evidence and possible mechanisms
papers.translated_title: 木质部脆弱性的热诱导增加：实验证据与可能机制
papers.author: Link, R. M.
papers.summary: Hotter droughts driven by global warming are increasing tree mortality worldwide. Here, we propose a theoretical framework that explains how dissolved gas affects the stability of bubbles in xylem sap, and shows that in the presence of gas, sudden increases in temperature can accelerate embolism formation. We then provide experimental evidence that heat exposure can change xylem vulnerability to drought. Using data from seven Australian and European tree species, we assessed how elevated temperature (+15 and +20 {degrees}C above ambient) affects both xylem embolism resistance, measured with the Optical Vulnerability Technique, and VPD-corrected drying times. We found evidence for reduced embolism resistance and accelerated dehydration in heat-exposed plants. On average, trees reached the water potential at 50% loss of xylem function at 0.73 MPa less negative water potentials and 7.8 kPa h earlier, though responses were highly species-specific, and credibly different from zero only in the Australian species. Our results are consistent with the proposed framework and suggest that embolism resistance may not be a static trait, which has important repercussions for studies of plant vulnerability to drought. Further studies are necessary to assess the potential effects of heat-induced reductions in embolism resistance on tree mortality during heatwaves.
papers.translated_summary: 全球变暖驱动的更严重干旱正在增加全球范围内的树木死亡率。在此，我们提出一个理论框架，解释溶解气体如何影响木质部汁液中气泡的稳定性，并表明在存在气体的情况下，温度突然升高会加速栓塞形成。随后，我们提供实验证据，表明热暴露可以改变木质部对干旱的脆弱性。利用来自七种澳大利亚和欧洲树种的数据，我们评估了升高温度（高于环境温度+15和+20摄氏度）如何影响木质部栓塞抗性（用光学脆弱性技术测量）和经VPD校正的干燥时间。我们发现了热暴露植物中栓塞抗性降低和脱水加速的证据。平均而言，树木在木质部功能损失50%时的水势提前了0.73 MPa（水势较不负）和7.8 kPa h，尽管响应具有高度物种特异性，并且仅在澳大利亚树种中可信地不同于零。我们的结果与所提出的框架一致，并表明栓塞抗性可能不是一个静态性状，这对植物干旱脆弱性研究具有重要影响。需要进一步研究来评估热诱导的栓塞抗性降低对热浪期间树木死亡率的潜在影响。

papers.title: Genome-wide latitudinal variation associated with defence and reproductive pathways linked to Norway spruce adaptation
papers.translated_title: 全基因组纬度变异与防御和繁殖途径相关，这些途径与挪威云杉适应性有关
papers.author: Ranade, S. S.
papers.summary: Environmental cues modulate the natural variations in genes that outline local adaptation in plants for optimal survival. Genome-wide analysis using exome capture dataset in Norway spruce (Picea abies L. Kast) in Sweden revealed natural allelic variation in coding regions of genes associated with defence and reproductive pathways that follow a latitudinal cline, despite of the weak population structure with a low genetic differentiation. Steepest clines in the allele frequencies of missense SNPs from coding region (cSNPs) were detected in 60S RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN L18 (RPL18C), a gene involved in plant survival and defence/stress responses and LONG AFTER FAR-RED 3 (LAF3) that mediates light responses. This was closely followed by cline in ZINC 4 FINGER DNA 3'-PHOSPHOESTERASE (ZDP), involved in DNA repair and DNA demethylation pathways. Flowering genes that displayed latitudinal cline in cSNPs included BARELY ANY MERISTEM 1 (BAM1), REDUCED VERNALIZATION RESPONSE 1 (VRN1), FLOWERING CONTROL LOCUS A (FCA) and TERMINAL FLOWER 1 (TFL1) among few others. These variations may contribute to differential functioning of the defence/flowering genes, enabling the tree to thrive at its best under given local environmental conditions. The clines provide evidence towards local adaptation in these Norway spruce populations across Sweden; it coincides with the latitudinal variation in climatic conditions including temperature, day length and light quality, along with existing cline e.g. differential growth and defence response, and bud-burst/bud-set. The knowledge can be applied in forest industry to design future sustainable breeding strategies e.g. assisted migration, in the context of inevitable climate change.
papers.translated_summary: 环境线索调节基因的自然变异，这些基因勾勒出植物局部适应以实现最佳生存。利用瑞典挪威云杉（Picea abies L. Kast）外显子组捕获数据集进行的全基因组分析揭示，与防御和生殖途径相关基因编码区的自然等位变异遵循纬度梯度，尽管种群结构较弱且遗传分化较低。编码区错义SNP（cSNP）等位基因频率最陡峭的梯度出现在60S核糖体蛋白L18（RPL18C）中，该基因参与植物生存和防御/胁迫响应，以及介导光响应的LONG AFTER FAR-RED 3（LAF3）。紧随其后的是ZINC 4 FINGER DNA 3'-PHOSPHOESTERASE（ZDP）的梯度，该基因参与DNA修复和DNA去甲基化途径。cSNP显示纬度梯度的开花基因包括BARELY ANY MERISTEM 1（BAM1）、REDUCED VERNALIZATION RESPONSE 1（VRN1）、FLOWERING CONTROL LOCUS A（FCA）和TERMINAL FLOWER 1（TFL1）等少数几个。这些变异可能有助于防御/开花基因的差异功能，使树木能够在给定局部环境条件下以最佳状态生长。这些梯度为瑞典这些挪威云杉种群的局部适应提供了证据；它与气候条件（包括温度、日长和光质）的纬度变化相吻合，并与现有梯度如差异生长和防御响应以及芽萌发/芽形成相一致。这些知识可应用于林业，以在不可避免的气候变化背景下设计未来可持续育种策略，例如辅助迁移。

papers.title: Antagonism between sugar-dependent O-fucosylation and BIN2-mediated phosphorylation regulates metabolism and growth in Arabidopsis
papers.translated_title: 糖依赖性O-岩藻糖基化与BIN2介导的磷酸化之间的拮抗作用调控拟南芥的代谢与生长
papers.author: Zhang, H.
papers.summary: Coordinating sugar sensing, hormone signaling, and carbon metabolism is crucial for plant growth and environmental acclimation. Brassinosteroid (BR)-dependent phosphorylation and sugar-dependent O-glycosylation modify overlapping sets of proteins, but how these modifications co-regulate protein functions remains unknown. Here, we show that SPINDLY (SPY)-catalyzed O-fucosylation competes with BIN2-mediated phosphorylation and antagonistically regulates phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 1 (PCK1), a key gluconeogenic enzyme. SPY associates with and O-fucosylates PCK1 within a peptide containing Ser-62 and Thr-66, two BIN2 phosphorylation sites that regulate PCK1 activity, preventing its phosphorylation by BIN2. PCK1 O-fucosylation and phosphorylation exclude each other and oppositely affect PCK1 activity in vivo. The spy mutants show increased PCK1 phosphorylation, reduced PCK activity, and impaired hypocotyl elongation; BR or BIN2 inhibitor treatments suppressed these phenotypes, indicating that these spy effects result from increased BIN2 phosphorylation. Together, these results reveal functional antagonism between SPY/O-fucosylation and BIN2/phosphorylation in regulating metabolism and growth
papers.translated_summary: 协调糖感知、激素信号传导和碳代谢对植物生长和环境适应至关重要。油菜素内酯（BR）依赖的磷酸化和糖依赖的O-糖基化修饰重叠的蛋白质集合，但这些修饰如何共同调控蛋白质功能仍不清楚。在此，我们表明SPINDLY（SPY）催化的O-岩藻糖基化与BIN2介导的磷酸化竞争，并拮抗性调控磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸羧激酶1（PCK1），一种关键的糖异生酶。SPY与PCK1结合并在包含Ser-62和Thr-66的肽段内对其进行O-岩藻糖基化，这两个BIN2磷酸化位点调控PCK1活性，从而阻止BIN2对其磷酸化。PCK1的O-岩藻糖基化和磷酸化相互排斥，并在体内对PCK1活性产生相反影响。spy突变体显示PCK1磷酸化增加、PCK活性降低和下胚轴伸长受损；BR或BIN2抑制剂处理抑制了这些表型，表明这些spy效应源于BIN2磷酸化增加。总之，这些结果揭示了SPY/O-岩藻糖基化与BIN2/磷酸化在调控代谢和生长中的功能性拮抗。

papers.title: Photoswitchable optoGPCRs for reversible control of Gs signalling and arrestin recruitment
papers.translated_title: 用于可逆控制Gs信号传导和抑制蛋白招募的光开关光遗传学GPCR
papers.author: Walter, D.
papers.summary: OptoGPCRs are light-activatable G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) used to optogenetically control physiological processes. Most existing optoGPCRs are based on monostable opsins, which are limited by photobleaching and irreversibility. The bistable jumping spider rhodopsin 1 (JSR1) carrying the single point mutant S199F introduces a ~150 nm spectral separation between the active and inactive states, enabling bidirectional control with distinct wavelengths of light. Here, we show that JSR1-S199F robustly and reversibly recruits arrestin and modulates Gq/i protein activity. We then engineered JSR1-S199F-based optoGPCRs with Gs protein activity, guided by AlphaFold-predicted receptor-miniGs complexes, to expand the limited repertoire of bistable Gs-coupled optoGPCRs. Specifically, we present optoDRD1, a chimeric optoGPCR that redirects the native Gq/i protein activity of JSR1 towards the Gs pathway of the dopamine D1 receptor (DRD1). Through systematic screening of intracellular domain combinations, we identified a chimeric configuration with the highest absolute cAMP output comprising ICL2, ICL3, helix 8, and the C-terminus from DRD1. The resulting optoGPCR is activated by violet light ({lambda}max = 397 nm) and deactivated by green light ({lambda}max = 531 nm) at physiologically relevant light intensities. A single violet light pulse drives sustained Gs signalling for several hours, while green light rapidly deactivates the receptor at any chosen time point, enabling repeatable switching between active and inactive states over multiple cycles. OptoDRD1 closely mimics wild-type DRD1 in both cAMP signalling kinetics and G protein selectivity, with a signal amplitude comparable to native Gs-coupled receptors, including JellyOp. We further demonstrate optoDRD1's utility for optogenetic control of Gs-regulated processes in vitro, including insulin secretion in human {beta}-cells and signalling modulation in a neuronal cell line. The biochemical stability and known structure of JSR1 make it a robust scaffold for this rational engineering and for future biophysical characterization. Together, optoDRD1 and JSR1-S199F expand the optoGPCR toolkit and open new opportunities for dissecting dopaminergic signalling, Gs-mediated physiology, and GPCR signalling pharmacology.
papers.translated_summary: 光遗传学G蛋白偶联受体（OptoGPCRs）是一类光可激活的G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs），用于光遗传学控制生理过程。现有大多数光遗传学GPCRs基于单稳态视蛋白，受限于光漂白和不可逆性。携带单点突变S199F的双稳态跳蛛视紫红质1（JSR1）在活性态与非活性态之间引入约150 nm的光谱间隔，从而能够以不同波长的光实现双向控制。在此，我们证明JSR1-S199F能够稳健且可逆地招募arrestin并调节Gq/i蛋白活性。随后，我们以AlphaFold预测的受体-miniGs复合物为指导，工程化改造了具有Gs蛋白活性的JSR1-S199F基光遗传学GPCRs，以扩展有限的双稳态Gs偶联光遗传学GPCRs库。具体而言，我们提出了optoDRD1，一种嵌合光遗传学GPCR，将JSR1天然的Gq/i蛋白活性重定向至多巴胺D1受体（DRD1）的Gs通路。通过对细胞内结构域组合的系统筛选，我们鉴定出一种具有最高绝对cAMP输出的嵌合构型，其包含来自DRD1的ICL2、ICL3、螺旋8和C末端。所得光遗传学GPCR在生理相关光强度下由紫光（λmax = 397 nm）激活、由绿光（λmax = 531 nm）失活。单次紫光脉冲可驱动持续的Gs信号传导数小时，而绿光可在任意选定时间点迅速使受体失活，从而在多个循环中实现活性态与非活性态之间的可重复切换。OptoDRD1在cAMP信号动力学和G蛋白选择性方面均紧密模拟野生型DRD1，其信号幅度与天然Gs偶联受体（包括JellyOp）相当。我们进一步证明了optoDRD1在体外光遗传学控制Gs调控过程中的实用性，包括人β细胞中的胰岛素分泌以及神经元细胞系中的信号调节。JSR1的生化稳定性和已知结构使其成为这一理性工程改造及未来生物物理表征的稳健支架。总之，optoDRD1和JSR1-S199F扩展了光遗传学GPCR工具包，并为剖析多巴胺能信号传导、Gs介导的生理过程以及GPCR信号药理学开辟了新机遇。

papers.title: Auditory cortex deviance detection represents a canonical difference signal
papers.translated_title: 听觉皮层的偏差检测代表了一种典型的差异信号
papers.author: Hockley, A.
papers.summary: Context modulates neural processing of sensory stimuli. Excitatory neuron responses are most often suppressed to stimuli that are typical of the current context and augmented to stimuli that are deviant. These effects have been extensively studied in basic and clinical neuroscience using oddball paradigms, involving the repeating of standard stimuli and the insertion of rare deviant stimuli. Augmented neural responses to deviants - referred to as deviance detection - have been interpreted within predictive coding frameworks as prediction errors, signaling the difference between internal predictions and actual sensory input. However, most oddball paradigms simultaneously alter both predictions and input, so cannot test for a true difference signal. As yet, no studies have demonstrated that neural deviance detection during oddball paradigms specifically encodes the difference between internal predictions and unexpected sensory input, as opposed to, e.g., a generalised surprise signal or augmented bottom-up signaling. Here we compare neural responses to auditory stimuli across oddball paradigm variants.In a classical oddball paradigm, responses of putative excitatory neurons in the primary auditory cortex (A1) to auditory deviants contain information about recent frequency change and retain a memory trace of previous stimulus context. Interestingly, in a fixed-deviant oddball paradigm where the standards (theoretical predictions) were altered between blocks, but deviant stimulus features remain unchanged, neural response patterns encoded standard-to-deviant frequency difference. Together, these findings support the interpretation that A1 deviance detection contains a sensory prediction error that represents the difference between prediction and sensory input, a corollary of the predictive coding framework.
papers.translated_summary: 情境调节感觉刺激的神经处理。兴奋性神经元的反应通常对符合当前情境特征的刺激受到抑制，而对偏离刺激则增强。这些效应已在基础与临床神经科学中通过oddball范式得到广泛研究，该范式涉及重复标准刺激并插入罕见偏离刺激。对偏离刺激增强的神经反应——被称为偏离检测——在预测编码框架下被解释为预测误差，标志着内部预测与实际感觉输入之间的差异。然而，大多数oddball范式同时改变预测和输入，因此无法检验真正的差异信号。迄今为止，尚无研究表明oddball范式中的神经偏离检测专门编码内部预测与意外感觉输入之间的差异，而非例如一般化的惊讶信号或增强的自下而上信号传递。在此，我们比较了不同oddball范式变体中对听觉刺激的神经反应。在经典oddball范式中，初级听觉皮层（A1）中推测的兴奋性神经元对听觉偏离刺激的反应包含关于近期频率变化的信息，并保留先前刺激情境的记忆痕迹。有趣的是，在固定偏离oddball范式中，当标准刺激（理论预测）在不同组块间改变，但偏离刺激特征保持不变时，神经反应模式编码了标准到偏离的频率差异。总之，这些发现支持这样的解释：A1偏离检测包含一个感觉预测误差，表征预测与感觉输入之间的差异，这是预测编码框架的一个推论。

papers.title: Long-read genome sequencing resolves complex structural variants in exome-negative developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
papers.translated_title: 长读长基因组测序解析外显子组阴性发育性和癫痫性脑病中的复杂结构变异
papers.author: Park, J.
papers.summary: Background and Objectives: Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathies (DEEs) encompass a clinically and molecularly heterogeneous group of mainly genetic disorders. Despite standard genetic testing, approximately two-thirds of patients remain undiagnosed. Pathogenic noncoding and structural variants (SVs), particularly complex rearrangements that are difficult to detect or resolve using short-read sequencing, may contribute to this diagnostic gap. To evaluate the diagnostic contribution of long-read genome sequencing (lrGS), we recruited a cohort of 124 families with sporadic DEE who remained unsolved by prior ES. Methods: Trio lrGS (Oxford Nanopore or PacBio HiFi) was performed, complemented zby short-read genome sequencing (srGS) and mRNA sequencing (blood or fibroblast) of index cases, where available. Comprehensive variant analysis included small nucleotide variants (SNVs), indels, SVs, and short tandem repeats. To identify the diagnostic yield of each method, we compared lrGS, srGS and ES re-analysis, and evaluated the additional value of RNA sequencing. Results: We established a diagnosis in 21 of 124 families (16.9%). Fourteen variants were retrospectively detectable in prior ES., Two cases with non-coding variants in SCN1A and RNU2-2 were detectable by both srGS and lrGS. Five SVs also required genome sequencing (5.6% of the total cohort), three of which could be detected, but not confidently resolved by srGS due to breakpoint complexity, repeat-mediated rearrangements, and large copy-neutral events: LrGS enabled accurate characterization of Alu-mediated CDKL5 and STXBP1 deletions and a MEF2C deletion with large inversion. A copy-neutral SCN1A inversion was well characterizable by both srGS and lrGS. One balanced translocation t(X;17) disrupting CDKL5 was resolved by lrGS (srGS unavailable). RNA sequencing confirmed pathogenicity of two SVs including t(X;17), the MEF2C deletion with inversion, and two CNVs. In addition, ZNF569 and ZNF570 emerged as candidate epilepsy genes from our cohort. Discussion: In ES-negative DEE, the incremental diagnostic yield of genome sequencing was modest, while lrGS provided particular value for the structural resolution of complex rearrangements, especially those involving repetitive sequences. The finding that two-thirds of diagnoses were retrospectively detectable in prior ES highlights the substantial value of systematic reanalysis. Further gains from genome sequencing may increasingly depend on improved interpretation of non-coding variation and integration of long-read-specific information. Our findings indicate that complex SVs represent the class for which lrGS currently yields the most distinctive diagnostic information.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：发育性及癫痫性脑病（DEEs）涵盖一组临床和分子高度异质性的、主要为遗传性的疾病。尽管进行了标准基因检测，约三分之二的患者仍未获得诊断。致病性非编码变异和结构变异（SVs），尤其是难以通过短读长测序检测或解析的复杂重排，可能导致了这一诊断缺口。为评估长读长基因组测序（lrGS）的诊断贡献，我们招募了一个由124个散发性DEE家系组成的队列，这些家系在先前的ES检测后仍未获得解答。方法：进行三联体lrGS（Oxford Nanopore或PacBio HiFi），并在可获得的情况下辅以先证者的短读长基因组测序（srGS）和mRNA测序（血液或成纤维细胞）。全面的变异分析包括小核苷酸变异（SNVs）、插入缺失、SVs和短串联重复序列。为确定每种方法的诊断率，我们比较了lrGS、srGS和ES再分析，并评估了RNA测序的附加价值。结果：我们在124个家系中的21个（16.9%）建立了诊断。十四个变异在先前的ES中可回顾性检测到。两例携带SCN1A和RNU2-2非编码变异的病例可通过srGS和lrGS检测到。五个SVs同样需要基因组测序（占队列总数的5.6%），其中三个可被检测到，但由于断点复杂性、重复介导的重排和大的拷贝中性事件而无法通过srGS可靠解析：lrGS使得对Alu介导的CDKL5和STXBP1缺失以及伴有大倒位的MEF2C缺失的准确表征成为可能。一个拷贝中性SCN1A倒位可通过srGS和lrGS良好表征。一个破坏CDKL5的平衡易位t(X;17)通过lrGS得以解析（srGS不可用）。RNA测序确认了两个SVs的致病性，包括t(X;17)、伴有倒位的MEF2C缺失，以及两个CNVs。此外，ZNF569和ZNF570在我们的队列中作为候选癫痫基因出现。讨论：在ES阴性的DEE中，基因组测序的增量诊断率有限，而lrGS对复杂重排的结构解析提供了特殊价值，尤其是涉及重复序列的重排。三分之二的诊断可在先前的ES中回顾性检测到这一发现，凸显了系统性再分析的重大价值。基因组测序的进一步收益可能日益依赖于对非编码变异解读的改进以及长读长特异性信息的整合。我们的发现表明，复杂SVs代表了lrGS目前产生最具特色诊断信息的那一类变异。

papers.title: Common centromeric variation associates with molecular and complex traits in humans
papers.translated_title: 常见的着丝粒变异与人类分子和复杂性状相关
papers.author: Dong, Y.
papers.summary: Human centromeres harbor extensive structural variation that has remained largely inaccessible to human genetics because their repetitive -satellite arrays are absent from standard reference and imputation panels. Here we catalog 188,589 centromeric structural variants (SVs) from haplotype-resolved long-read assemblies of 196 Human Pangenome Reference Consortium individuals aligned to the telomere-to-telomere CHM13 reference. Resolving recurrent SVs into monophyletic components along centromeric haplotype phylogenies makes them imputable from pericentromeric SNPs (mean R2CV = 0.407 vs. 0.065 unresolved). In 124 individuals with haplotype-resolved nanopore methylation, we identify 418 same-chromosome SV-CpG associations that form local hypomethylation-enriched domains in the centromeric region, most strongly for deletions. We also show that a truncated 113-bp monomer on chromosome 8 is associated with the position of the CENP-A-associated centromere dip region (CDR) at n = 151, independent of array length. Imputed into 630 individuals with expression and splicing data, centromeric SVs are associated with 141 genes, 14 of them new relative to the SNP-based cis-QTL analysis, including the H3K9 methyltransferase SUV39H1. In 315,204 All of Us participants, we identify 170 associations between 61 SV predictors and 27 clinical phenotypes, including substance-related disorders and breast cancer. Our study brings a previously inaccessible class of variation into population-scale genetics and links centromeric SVs to centromere organization, gene expression, splicing and complex traits.

papers.title: Benchmark Self-Triage (BeST): Comparing Self-Triage Systems and Multiple Generations of OpenAI Models Against Preliminary Expert Consensus
papers.translated_title: 基准自我分诊（BeST）：比较自我分诊系统与多代OpenAI模型相对于初步专家共识的表现
papers.author: Kroll, L. E.
papers.summary: As digital self-triage becomes more widely used, quality assurance requires evaluation of both emergency recognition and overall agreement with clinical judgement, including how these outcomes differ across generations of large language models. The Benchmark Self-Triage (BeST) project intends to provide a framework to compare systems for digital self-triage against a medical 'gold standard' in Germany. As a first step in developing and demonstrating the methodology, we compared study-specific implementations of SmED 5.4.11 accessed via API and Infermedica Engine API via Microsoft Azure Healthcare Agent Service with five structured OpenAI configurations spanning multiple model generations: gpt-4.1, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, and gpt-6-astra. The manufacturers of SmED and Infermedica offer MDR-certified Class IIb triage products, but these certified products were not directly evaluated. An LLM-based patient actor covered 480 physician-curated vignettes derived from German routine triage data. A pool of seven physicians provided preliminary reference classifications and consensus for 480 vignettes. Recommendations were mapped to three urgency categories-emergency, acute, and not urgent-and evaluated using winsorised weights derived from routine triage frequencies. Weighted emergency sensitivity ranged from 51.3% (95% CI 35.5-66.3%) for gpt-4.1 to 99.9% (99.7-100.0%) for gpt-6-astra. Weighted exact three-category agreement (accuracy) ranged from 54.4% to 68.8%; gpt-4.1 achieved the highest agreement despite the lowest emergency sensitivity. No system performed best across all urgency categories. The later-generation OpenAI configurations showed a more precautionary triage profile resembling SmED, with higher sensitivity for emergency cases; gpt-6-astra showed the strongest shift. This cross-sectional comparison across model generations suggests a shift towards more precautionary triage behaviour, without establishing a longitudinal improvement in accuracy. These findings highlight the limitations of overall agreement for evaluating self-triage and support category-specific assessment. Broader expert consensus and evaluation, as well as further steps to reduce dependence on SmED-derived source data, are needed and planned before drawing conclusions about clinical safety.

papers.title: Defining and Characterizing Visits To Emergency Departments For Musculoskeletal Conditions: A Retrospective Analysis Using Two Publicly Available Databases

papers.author: Wrightson, J. G.
papers.summary: Introduction There are multiple ways to define and identify potentially avoidable emergency department (ED) visits, making it difficult to estimate their frequency accurately. In this study, we compared the proportions and characteristics of potentially avoidable ED visits identified using three commonly used algorithms. Methods We analysed the publicly available Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV Emergency Department dataset to estimate the proportions and characteristics of potentially avoidable ED visits identified using i) the eventual discharge diagnosis (Diagnosis), ii) the use of hospital resources (Resources), and iii) the triage acuity score assigned to the patient during emergency department triage (Triage Acuity). Results The proportion of visits identified as potentially avoidable differed significantly between algorithms (7 - 36%), and few visits (<2%) were identified as potentially avoidable by all three algorithms. Presenting complaints, discharge diagnoses, and patient demographics were all similarly affected. We found that the proportions and characteristics of potentially avoidable ED visits were affected by the algorithm used to identify them. Conclusion Methods for identifying potentially avoidable ED visits are not interchangeable. Choosing the appropriate definition and classification method will require researchers to carefully consider the types of visits and the characteristics of patients they wish to identify.

papers.title: Environmental toxic metal exposure and conditional mortality survival among US adults: a prospective cohort study
papers.translated_title: 环境有毒金属暴露与美国成年人条件性死亡生存：一项前瞻性队列研究
papers.author: Fang, X.
papers.summary: Abstract Background. Chronic low-level exposure to lead, cadmium, mercury, and arsenic remains a determinant of premature mortality in the U.S. general population, but previous hazard-ratio analyses do not characterize how exposure shifts the lower tail of the survival distribution, where premature mortality is concentrated. Objectives. We estimated the association of whole-blood lead, whole-blood total mercury, urinary cadmium, and the sum of urinary inorganic and methylated arsenic species with the 10th, 25th, and 50th conditional quantiles of follow-up time to all-cause mortality among U.S. adults aged 40 years and older. Methods. NHANES Continuous 1999 to 2018 was linked to the National Death Index through December 31, 2019 (n = 29,652). Censored quantile regression was fit per metal on the log2 scale at quantiles {tau}{0.10, 0.25, 0.50}. A restricted-cubic-spline (RCS) censored-quantile-regression was fit for blood lead and urinary cadmium to investigate the threshold effect. Results. Over a median follow-up of 9.1 years, 7,215 deaths were ascertained. A doubling of urinary cadmium was associated with -1.57 years of follow-up (95% CI: -2.08, -1.07) at the 10th conditional quantile, -1.50 (-2.04, -0.96) at the 25th, and -1.49 (-1.93, -1.04) at the median (Benjamini Hochberg q < 0.001 throughout). A doubling of whole-blood lead was associated with -0.70 years (95% CI: -0.99, -0.40) at the 10th conditional quantile, -0.62 (-0.92,-0.31) at the 25th, and -0.61 years (-0.89, -0.34) at the median; the absolute loss was largest at {tau} = 0.10 for both metals. Urinary arsenic-metabolite sum was not associated with conditional follow-up at the estimable quantiles. Despite adjustment for dark and fatty-fish intake or DHA/EPA, whole-blood total mercury was associated with longer follow-up (i.e., negatively associated with mortality risk), possibly due to residual confounding by broader dietary or socioeconomic factors, rather than a true protective effect. The cadmium association was additionally robust to the mutual adjustment of lead. Discussion. Low-to-moderate urinary cadmium and whole-blood lead were associated with fewer years of follow-up survival at the lower-tail and median conditional quantiles of survival, with the largest absolute losses at the lower tail of the conditional survival distribution, where premature mortality is concentrated. These findings support continued reductions in U.S. cadmium exposure and lead with particular benefit for adults most vulnerable to premature death.

papers.title: HOW SAFE IS EXERCISE? CROSS-SECTIONAL ASSOCIATIONS OF CURRENT PHYSICAL ACTIVITY WITH SELF-REPORTED FRACTURE HISTORY IN MID-LIFE
papers.translated_title: 运动有多安全？当前体力活动与中年自报骨折史的横断面关联
papers.author: Rolls, C.
papers.summary: ObjectiveTo examine associations between the volume and intensity of leisure-time physical activity (LTPA) and fracture during mid-life, and whether adherence to World Health Organization (WHO) physical activity recommendations was associated with fracture. MethodsCross-sectional analysis of 322,749 UK Biobank participants aged 40-65 years using self-reported physical activity and fracture data. LTPA volume (LTPAv) was derived from walking, moderate and vigorous activity. Participants were categorised into LTPAv quintiles and by adherence to WHO physical activity recommendations. Multivariable logistic regression examined associations with self-reported fracture within the previous five years, with analyses stratified by sex and adjusted for sociodemographic and anthropometric factors. Walking, moderate and vigorous activity were mutually adjusted to examine associations by intensity. ResultsParticipants had a mean age of 47 years and 53% were female. Odds of fracture increased with higher LTPAv, although associations were non-linear and varied by age and sex. Associations were strongest in the highest quintile among men and women aged 40-49 years (OR 1.81, 95% CI 1.64-1.99 and OR 1.42, 95% CI 1.28-1.58, respectively). Vigorous activity demonstrated the strongest independent association with fracture. Meeting, without exceeding, WHO physical activity recommendations was not associated with increased odds of fracture. ConclusionsHigher LTPA volumes were associated with greater odds of fracture, particularly vigorous activity, with associations strongest in younger adults and men. Activity consistent with WHO recommendations was not associated with greater odds of fracture, supporting continued promotion of physical activity during mid-life.

papers.title: Peripheral Predictors of Speech in Noise Deficits in a Population Cohort
papers.translated_title: 人群队列中言语噪声缺陷的外周预测因素
papers.author: Cederroth, C. R.
papers.summary: Background Age-related hearing loss is the leading sensory deficit in older adults, yet audiometric thresholds at conventional frequencies often poorly predict speech understanding. Two competing hypotheses have emerged: extended high-frequency (eHF) hearing loss beyond 8 kHz may unmask variance in speech performance, while cochlear synaptopathy, inferred via auditory brainstem response (ABR) wave I amplitude reduction, may degrade temporal coding independent of audiometry. This study aims to identify the best predictors of speech in noise deficits in the general population. Methods This is a cross-sectional analysis of 526 ears from 263 tinnitus-free adults (178 [67.7%] women and 85 men based on self-reported gender) enrolled in the Swedish Tinnitus Outreach Project, a population-based cohort study. Participants underwent air-conduction audiometry from 0.5 to 16 kHz, loudness discomfort levels, distortion product otoacoustic emissions, click-evoked ABR, and standardized speech-in-noise and word recognition testing in a clinical setting. Their associations with age and speech outcomes were evaluated using multivariable regression models. Results eHF pure-tone average was the most age-sensitive auditory metric, accounting for 64% of age-related variance, compared with 16% for PTA4 (the pure tone average of audiometric thresholds at 0.5, 1, 2, 4 kHz). eHF PTA thresholds (pure-tone average at 10-16 kHz) predicted speech-in-noise performance substantially better than PTA4, otoacoustic emissions, or ABR measures. ABR wave I amplitude did not significantly contribute to speech outcomes, even in high-reliability recordings (ICC = 0.96), whereas prolonged wave I latency was associated with poorer word recognition, particularly in older adults. In young adults, delayed wave I latency minimally affected word recognition, but in older adults an increase in latency from approximately 1.0 to 1.8 ms was associated with about a 27-percentage-point reduction in word recognition scores. Conclusions These findings identify eHF audiometry as a dominant clinical predictor of both cochlear aging and speech outcomes, and challenge the translational relevance of ABR-based synaptopathy markers in heterogeneous human populations, with implications for hearing assessment, clinical trials, and early intervention targeting in aging cohorts.

papers.title: Integrating GWAS meta-analysis with human brain cell mapping implicates the amygdala and cortical inhibitory interneurons in tinnitus
papers.translated_title: 将GWAS荟萃分析与人类脑细胞图谱相结合，揭示杏仁核和皮层抑制性中间神经元在耳鸣中的作用
papers.author: Schubert, N. M.
papers.summary: Purpose: Tinnitus is a common and heterogeneous condition whose genetic architecture remains poorly defined and whose definition varies across studies. We asked which common genetic variants are associated with tinnitus, to what extent genetic associations are shared across heterogeneous tinnitus definitions, and in which brain cell populations tinnitus heritability is concentrated. Methods: Genome-wide association meta-analysis of 19 independent population-based cohorts from Europe and the United States (hereby named EARGEN), comprising 961,085 adults of European ancestry (75,584 tinnitus cases and 885,501 controls). Tinnitus was defined by self-report in 17 cohorts and by diagnostic codes in two. Single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) based heritability and genetic correlations were estimated by linkage disequilibrium score regression, genes were mapped by gene-based association together with positional and expression quantitative trait locus mapping. Heritability enrichment was tested by stratified linkage disequilibrium score regression across 31 brain cell superclusters derived from post-mortem human brain donors, and across the 461 cell clusters that compose them. Enrichment was tested for replication in the Million Veteran Program (MVP) under a self-report definition (114,325 cases, 201,343 controls) and a diagnostic-code definition (77,601 cases, 310,953 controls). Results: Five independent loci reached genome-wide significance (p < 5 x 10-8) on chromosomes 2, 8, 12, 13 and 16, two of which (rs10877884 and rs2147632) have not been reported previously. SNP-based heritability was 0.0137 (SE = 0.0009) on the observed scale and 0.0535 (0.0036) on the liability scale. Genetic correlations were significant with hearing loss, anxiety disorder, major depressive disorder, chronic pain, and four further psychiatric, sleep and vestibular traits. Three superclusters showed a suggestive enrichment in the midbrain-derived inhibitory neurons, amygdala excitatory neurons, and medial ganglionic eminence interneurons at a false discovery rate (FRD) of 0.067, the two latter of which reached significance in the Million Veteran Program (MVP) under the diagnostic-code definition (0.030 and 0.006). At cluster resolution, the amygdala excitatory cluster was found significant (z = 4.82, false discovery rate = 3.3 x 10-4), whereas none of the ascending auditory relay cluster were found enriched (z [≤] 1.71, false discovery rate [≥] 0.21). Conclusion: Tinnitus-associated common variation concentrates in limbic and cortical neuronal populations rather than in the ascending auditory pathway. The predisposition to tinnitus therefore appears to be central and largely non-auditory in origin. The small number of genome-wide significant associations obtained despite a large sample emphasizes the need for more detailed and standardized phenotyping focusing on the tinnitus disorder.

papers.title: Trends in Cardiovascular Risk Factors, Disease Management, and Predicted Cardiovascular Risk Among US Adults, 1999-2023
papers.translated_title: 1999-2023年美国成年人心血管危险因素、疾病管理及预测心血管风险的趋势
papers.author: Ahmed, H. M.
papers.summary: Background: Cardiovascular risk factors have changed in the United States, but trends in prevalence, management, and predicted risk through the post-pandemic period remain incompletely characterized. Methods: We analyzed 11 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) periods (1999-2000 through 2021-2023) among 60,199 nonpregnant adults aged 20 years. Survey-weighted regression assessed age-standardized trends, subgroup differences, and measurement-change sensitivity. We assessed awareness, treatment, and control of hypertension, dyslipidemia, and diabetes. PREVENT equations estimated 10- and 30-year risks among adults without self-reported cardiovascular disease (CVD). Results: Obesity increased from 47.4% to 57.2% (odds ratio [OR] per decade, 1.23; 95% CI, 1.16-1.30), with class III obesity more than doubling (4.7% to 9.7%). Diabetes increased from 8.2% to 12.7% (OR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.19-1.34), while current smoking declined from 24.4% to 14.9% (OR, 0.76; 95% CI, 0.71-0.81). Hypertension, dyslipidemia, chronic kidney disease, and prior CVD showed no significant linear trends, although mean systolic blood pressure (BP) (124.2 to 120.2 mm Hg) and total cholesterol (203.6 to 188.1 mg/dL) declined, alongside improvements in other lipids. Hypertension and dyslipidemia awareness and treatment increased, but BP control peaked at 32.5% in 2013-2014 before declining to 21.5%, while LDL cholesterol control rose from 17.0% to 34.2%. Diabetes awareness increased, but treatment trends were nonsignificant. Glycemic control peaked at 51.2% in 2003-2004 before declining to 41.9% (P for nonlinearity <0.001). Predicted 10-year total CVD risk declined from 5.66% to 5.28%; atherosclerotic CVD (ASCVD) risk declined by 0.16 percentage points per decade (95% CI, 0.22 to 0.09), while heart failure (HF) risk increased by 0.10 (95% CI, 0.03-0.17). Their 2021-2023 estimates were nearly identical (3.20% and 3.19%, respectively); 30-year risks showed similar divergence. Conclusions: Improvements in smoking, blood pressure, and lipids coexisted with rising obesity and diabetes, declining blood pressure control after earlier gains, and divergent predicted ASCVD and HF risks.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：美国的心血管危险因素已发生变化，但大流行后时期的患病率、管理和预测风险趋势仍未得到充分描述。方法：我们分析了11个美国国家健康与营养调查（NHANES）周期（1999-2000年至2021-2023年）中60,199名年龄20岁的非妊娠成年人。调查加权回归评估了年龄标准化趋势、亚组差异和测量变化敏感性。我们评估了高血压、血脂异常和糖尿病的知晓率、治疗率和控制率。PREVENT方程估算了无自报心血管疾病（CVD）成年人的10年和30年风险。结果：肥胖率从47.4%上升至57.2%（每十年比值比[OR]为1.23；95% CI，1.16-1.30），III级肥胖增加了一倍以上（4.7%至9.7%）。糖尿病从8.2%上升至12.7%（OR，1.26；95% CI，1.19-1.34），而当前吸烟率从24.4%下降至14.9%（OR，0.76；95% CI，0.71-0.81）。高血压、血脂异常、慢性肾脏病和既往CVD未显示显著的线性趋势，尽管平均收缩压（BP）（124.2至120.2 mm Hg）和总胆固醇（203.6至188.1 mg/dL）下降，同时其他血脂指标也有所改善。高血压和血脂异常的知晓率和治疗率增加，但血压控制率在2013-2014年达到32.5%的峰值后下降至21.5%，而LDL胆固醇控制率从17.0%上升至34.2%。糖尿病知晓率增加，但治疗趋势不显著。血糖控制率在2003-2004年达到51.2%的峰值后下降至41.9%（非线性P<0.001）。预测的10年总CVD风险从5.66%下降至5.28%；动脉粥样硬化性CVD（ASCVD）风险每十年下降0.16个百分点（95% CI，0.22至0.09），而心力衰竭（HF）风险增加0.10（95% CI，0.03-0.17）。其2021-2023年估计值几乎相同（分别为3.20%和3.19%）；30年风险显示出类似的分化。结论：吸烟、血压和血脂的改善与肥胖和糖尿病的上升并存，血压控制率在早期改善后下降，以及预测的ASCVD和HF风险出现分化。

papers.title: Elevated HbA1c is associated with advanced brain age in severe obesity
papers.translated_title: 在严重肥胖中，HbA1c升高与大脑年龄提前相关
papers.author: Juhasz, J.
papers.summary: Introduction: Brain-predicted age, estimated from structural MRI data, is a machine-learning biomarker of biological brain aging. Greater brain age gap (BAG) indicates advanced brain aging and is associated with cognitive decline and mortality. Cardiometabolic risk factors, including elevated blood glucose, body mass index (BMI), blood pressure, and cholesterol, increase risk of cognitive impairment and dementia in aging. Their relationship with BAG in severe obesity remains poorly characterized despite increased prevalence of cardiometabolic risk factors among this population. Methods: T1-weighted MRI data from 97 adults (BMI 35-73) were used to calculate BAG using ENIGMA and Pyment brain age models. Associations between BAG and HbA1c, BMI, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia were examined using multiple linear regression and MM-estimation robust regression, adjusting for age, sex, and race. Post hoc analyses stratified models by clinical HbA1c cutoffs (normoglycemic, prediabetic, diabetic). Results: Higher HbA1c was associated with greater BAGENIGMA (B = 1.58, p = .014) and BAGPyment (B = 0.93, p = .013) in linear regression models. In robust models, HbA1c remained significantly associated with BAGENIGMA (B = 1.70, p = .002) but not BAGPyment (B = 0.71, p = .13). BMI, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia were not associated with BAG in either linear or robust models. HbA1c was associated with greater BAGENIGMA (B = 2.15, p = .01) and BAGPyment (B =1.21, p = .04) in those at or above prediabetic levels and with BAGENIGMA (B = 2.49, p = .047) in those with diabetes. Conclusions: Elevated HbA1c is associated with accelerated brain aging in individuals with severe obesity. BAG was not associated with BMI, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia, which may reflect the restricted BMI range inherent to the sample with severe obesity.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：通过结构MRI数据估算的大脑预测年龄是一种反映大脑生物学衰老的机器学习生物标志物。较大的脑龄差（BAG）表明大脑衰老加速，并与认知功能下降和死亡率相关。心脏代谢危险因素，包括血糖升高、体重指数（BMI）、血压和胆固醇升高，会增加衰老过程中认知障碍和痴呆的风险。尽管重度肥胖人群中这些心脏代谢危险因素的患病率增加，但其与BAG的关系仍鲜有明确描述。方法：使用来自97名成年人（BMI 35-73）的T1加权MRI数据，通过ENIGMA和Pyment大脑年龄模型计算BAG。采用多元线性回归和MM估计稳健回归检验BAG与HbA1c、BMI、高血压和高脂血症之间的关联，并校正年龄、性别和种族。事后分析按临床HbA1c截断值（血糖正常、糖尿病前期、糖尿病）对模型进行分层。结果：在线性回归模型中，较高的HbA1c与较大的BAGENIGMA（B = 1.58，p = .014）和BAGPyment（B = 0.93，p = .013）相关。在稳健模型中，HbA1c仍与BAGENIGMA显著相关（B = 1.70，p = .002），但与BAGPyment不相关（B = 0.71，p = .13）。BMI、高血压和高脂血症在线性或稳健模型中均与BAG无关。在处于或高于糖尿病前期水平者中，HbA1c与较大的BAGENIGMA（B = 2.15，p = .01）和BAGPyment（B = 1.21，p = .04）相关；在糖尿病患者中，HbA1c与BAGENIGMA相关（B = 2.49，p = .047）。结论：HbA1c升高与重度肥胖个体的大脑衰老加速相关。BAG与BMI、高血压和高脂血症无关，这可能反映了重度肥胖样本固有的BMI范围受限。
